import sys

def minChar(S):
    n = len(S)
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    
    # Create the string T = S + '#' + reverse(S)
    rev_S = S[::-1]
    T = S + '#' + rev_S
    m = len(T)
    
    # Compute LPS array (Longest Prefix Suffix) for T
    lps = [0] * m
    length = 0  # length of the previous longest prefix suffix
    i = 1
    
    while i < m:
        if T[i] == T[length]:
            length += 1
            lps[i] = length
            i += 1
        else:
            if length != 0:
                length = lps[length - 1]
            else:
                lps[i] = 0
                i += 1
    
    # The length of the longest palindromic prefix of S is lps[-1]
    longest_pal_prefix_len = lps[-1]
    
    # Minimum characters to add at front
    return n - longest_pal_prefix_len

# Reading input from stdin
if __name__ == "__main__":
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    result = minChar(s)
    print(result)
